title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Hold Thresholds and Time Limits
content:
These are the tier figures of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program that govern shipment holds and the time limits after which a program closes administratively.

| Tier | Past-due age in days | Past-due hold minimum | Inpatient hold required | Hold limit (calendar days from the hold start date) | Referral documentation window (calendar days from the enrolled date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 15 | 50.00 USD | No | 180 | 30 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 90 | 75.00 USD | Yes | 60 | 30 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 75.00 USD | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 120 | 75.00 USD | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 120 | 75.00 USD | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 0 (never held for a past-due balance) | 75.00 USD | Yes | 60 | 30 |

## Definitions

- **Past-due age in days**: the age, in calendar days after its posting date, at which an unpaid patient-balance posting becomes past due for the shipment hold test. A figure of 0 means shipments are never held for a past-due balance on the tier.
- **Past-due hold minimum**: the past-due amount at or above which further shipments are held under the past-due rule.
- **Inpatient hold required**: whether shipments must be held while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility, because the payer does not pay home supplies during a covered stay.
- **Hold limit**: the longest time a program may remain on hold before it is closed administratively.
- **Referral documentation window**: the time allowed to complete the referral documentation (the written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided).

## Both sides of the hold minimum (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical tier with a hold minimum of 60.00 USD, a past-due amount of 59.99 USD is below the minimum, and a past-due amount of exactly 60.00 USD is at the minimum and therefore meets it.

## Reading across the tiers

- The CGM Self-Pay Program has the shortest past-due age (15 days), the lowest hold minimum (50.00 USD), no inpatient hold and the longest hold limit (180 days).
- The CGM Medicaid Program shows a 75.00 USD minimum, but with a past-due age of 0 it never holds shipments for a past-due balance.
